result.topic_en: Pencil calculation transforming an integral of w with respect to ξ^{ν/2}, involving a power ((1−y)/y)^{−μ−1/2} and the expression (ξ^{1/2}−ξ^{−1/2})/2, by substituting a new variable t and factoring tt + 1/tt − ξ − 1/ξ.
result.transcription:
$\int w\, d\xi^{\frac{\nu}{2}} =$
$\int\int_0 \left(\frac{1-y}{y}\right)^{-\mu-\frac12} \frac{\partial y}{y^{\frac12}} \left(1 + \left(\frac{\xi^{\frac12}-\xi^{-\frac12}}{2}\right)^2 y\right)^{\nu} d\xi^{\frac{\nu}{2}}$[?]
[-$\frac{(\xi+1)^2}{4\xi}\, y + \left(1-\frac{1}{x}\right) 4\xi$-][?]
[-$\frac{\xi}{y} = \sqrt{\left(1+\left(t-\frac{1}{x}\right)\frac{2}{y}\frac{\xi}{\frac12}\right)^2 - 1} - 1 + \left(1-\frac{1}{x}\right)^2$-][?]
$\left(\frac{1}{y} - 1 + \frac{1}{x}\right)^{-\mu-\frac12} \frac{\partial y}{y^{\frac12}} \left(1 + \left(\frac{\xi^{\frac12}-\xi^{-\frac12}}{2}\right)^2 y\right)$
$\frac{1}{y} = -\left(\frac{t - [-\ldots-]\frac{1}{t}}{2}\right)^2$[?]
$\left(-\left(\frac{t-\frac{1}{t}}{2}\right)^2 \partial y + \frac{1}{x}\right)^{-\mu-\frac12}$[?]
$\partial y = \frac{2t}{tt-1}$[?] $\left(\frac{t-\frac{1}{t}}{2}\right)^2 - \left(\frac{\xi^{\frac12}-\xi^{-\frac12}}{2}\right)^2$
$tt + \frac{1}{tt} - \xi - \frac{1}{\xi}$
$\frac{(tt-\xi)\left(tt-\frac{1}{\xi}\right)}{tt}$

methods.what: Substitution expressing 1/y as a negative square of (t − 1/t)/2 to transform the integrand
Factorization of a difference of squares in t and ξ
Representation of the integral of w as a double integral with a Euler-type kernel
